title: Grilled Satay Skewers with Yuzu Dipping Sauce
description: A fusion of Japanese flavors and Malaysian street food, these grilled satay skewers are served with a refreshing yuzu dipping sauce.

ingredients.name: Yuzu Juice
ingredients.notes: Can be found in most Asian markets or online

instructions: 2. Cut satay into 1-inch pieces and thread onto skewers.
3. In a small bowl, whisk together soy sauce, yuzu juice, and sesame oil.
4. Brush the mixture onto both sides of the satay.
5. Grill for 2-3 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
6. Serve hot with dipping sauce and garnish with cilantro.
